title: UCSB: 3D Through-Wall Imaging with Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
verified_finding: The 2017 research uses coordinated UAV transmitter/receiver measurements and received signal strength to reconstruct obscured structures in a controlled arrangement.
not_established: Not an unmodified consumer drone, arbitrary phone scanner, or universal live room reconstruction.

title: UCSB: Wiffract / WiFi Reading Through Wall
verified_finding: The work reconstructs edges using diffraction-related measurements and spatial scanning, including letter-shaped objects behind an obstruction.
not_established: Not reading arbitrary printed documents or proof of general indoor scene understanding.

title: MIT: RF-Pose
verified_finding: RF-Pose reports through-occlusion human-pose estimation using radio input and visual supervision during training.
not_established: Not a generic router SDK, an identity detector, or qualification for medical assessment.

title: Espressif ESP-CSI
verified_finding: Espressif provides channel-state acquisition and sensing examples, including motion/presence-oriented work.
not_established: Hardware, firmware, environment and algorithm performance must be qualified separately; no Haven benchmarks exist.

title: IEEE 802.11 Working Group
verified_finding: The working group reports publication of the WLAN sensing amendment IEEE 802.11bf-2025 on September 26, 2025.
not_established: Publication does not establish support or accessible measurements in a particular phone, router or driver.

title: CompSLAM: Complementary Multi-Modal Sensor Fusion for Robust SLAM
version_or_publication: 2025 preprint; verify paper revision before replication
verified_finding: The authors describe complementary sensing for localization/mapping in degraded environments with subterranean robotics field experience.
not_established: A research result and code lead, not turnkey Haven navigation or validated rescue reliability.

title: Mobile ALOHA
verified_finding: The project demonstrates mobile bimanual manipulation learned from demonstrations, with a teleoperation/data-collection platform.
not_established: Task demonstrations do not imply safe autonomous operation in an arbitrary occupied home.

title: LeRobot SO-101
verified_finding: The documentation provides sourcing, printed-part and assembly/calibration guidance for the SO-101 platform.
not_established: A buildable development arm is not a qualified assistive or rescue product.

title: LeRobot LeKiwi
verified_finding: The documentation covers a mobile robot platform and teleoperation-oriented setup with printable hardware.
not_established: Exact BOM, software, stopping behavior and integration must be qualified on the selected build.

title: Physical Intelligence openpi
verified_finding: The repository exposes policy-model code and checkpoints. Its published resource table distinguishes inference, LoRA and full fine-tuning, with different GPU memory needs.
not_established: No inference fit, task quality or hardware compatibility on Eric's desktop has been measured. System RAM is not GPU memory.

title: Gemini Robotics On-Device
verified_finding: The current On-Device 2 page presents local robot-action modeling and labels access as trusted testers.
not_established: Not a generally downloadable dependency or permission to command Haven hardware.

title: UZH Robotics and Perception Group: Swift drone-racing work
verified_finding: The lab describes its Nature 2023 champion-level drone-racing work combining learning in simulation with real-world racing.
not_established: Performance in a race setting does not transfer automatically to cluttered rescue or consumer-aircraft control.

title: NIST: Modular and Autonomous Laboratory Ecosystem
verified_finding: NIST describes work on standards supporting modular and autonomous laboratory systems.
not_established: A standards/research direction, not a finished household engineering agent or certification.

title: Berkeley autonomous experimentation / A-Lab research
verified_finding: The group describes autonomous experimentation combining planning, experimental execution and analysis in materials research.
not_established: No chemistry replication is proposed here. Novel-material counts must not be repeated without reconciling the correction in R15.

title: A-Lab author correction
verified_finding: The January 2026 correction distinguishes materials new to the prediction platform from materials new to science, revises diffraction-based success claims and removes a training-data inclusion.
not_established: The corrected work remains a useful autonomous-experimentation precedent, not proof that every generated novelty/success claim is reliable. Detailed reproduction requires the corrected article and supplements.

title: Drone delivery of AEDs before ambulance arrival in real-life suspected cardiac arrests
verified_finding: A Swedish prospective observational study reports real emergency-service drone AED deliveries. Among 55 cases with comparable arrival times, 37 deliveries preceded ambulance arrival.
not_established: Not a randomized survival-effect estimate, universal delivery reliability, or authorization for a home-built medical-delivery service.

title: CadQuery introduction
verified_finding: CadQuery supports programmatic parametric CAD and engineering/mesh exports.
not_established: Generated geometry alone does not prove manufacturability, load capacity or material safety.

title: OctoPrint job API
verified_finding: The documented API includes print-job state and controls such as start, pause and cancel.
not_established: Not universal printer compatibility, a machine-safety controller, or approval for unattended printing.

title: NIOSH: Approaches to Safe 3D Printing
verified_finding: NIOSH discusses particle/chemical emissions, thermal, mechanical and electrical hazards and approaches to exposure control for small printing workspaces.
not_established: An enclosure alone is not proof of adequate ventilation or safe operation for every material.

title: Meshtastic introduction
verified_finding: Meshtastic documents off-grid LoRa-based messaging and location-related capabilities with compatible nodes.
not_established: Not broadband internet, universal range or an authorized emergency dispatch interface.

title: IETF Bundle Protocol Version 7
verified_finding: RFC 9171 specifies a store-and-forward bundle protocol for delay/disruption-tolerant networking.
not_established: Haven need not implement the full protocol in an initial local message-outbox demonstration.

title: Nous Research Hermes Agent
verified_finding: Hermes is MIT-licensed agent software with tools, memory/skills and provider options.
not_established: The framework is not a free inference model or proof of safe household isolation.

title: Hermes provider documentation
version_or_publication: Live provider guide checked during preparation
verified_finding: The reviewed guide requires a 64,000-token configured context for tool-using agents and discusses local endpoints.
not_established: A small standalone-model benchmark does not qualify the entire framework. Recheck the selected release.

title: Meta: Introducing Muse
verified_finding: Meta describes a hosted personal-agent product powered by Muse Spark with free and paid use.
not_established: This announcement does not establish downloadable weights, self-hosting, or a public interchangeable inference API for Haven.

title: Qwen3.5-4B model card
verified_finding: The model card identifies a compact multimodal model and its Apache-2.0 license.
not_established: No Haven task quality, speed, energy or memory results have been measured.

title: Gemma 3 4B serving artifact
verified_finding: Ollama publishes a Gemma 3 4B artifact under Gemma terms.
not_established: Open weights are not synonymous with Apache/MIT licensing; artifact size is not total runtime memory.

title: Ollama structured outputs
verified_finding: Ollama documents schema-constrained outputs including use with vision inputs.
not_established: Schema validity is not factual correctness, medical reliability or permission to act.

title: Codex AGENTS.md guidance
verified_finding: Codex documentation describes using AGENTS.md as project instructions.
not_established: An instructions file is not a technical permission boundary or evidence that an agent executed a task.

title: Meta Wearables Device Access Toolkit for iOS
verified_finding: The developer-preview SDK lists camera, audio, display, input and motion-related features. Some capture/audio features are explicitly experimental and unavailable for production publishing.
not_established: One capability does not imply all glasses models support every interface. Exact SKU, SDK, permission and release channel need qualification.

title: Apple RoomPlan
verified_finding: RoomPlan uses camera/LiDAR on supported Apple hardware to produce parametric room representations.
not_established: It observes a scanned room; it is not through-wall sensing and does not establish present conditions from historical scans.

title: DJI Matrice 4 accessory specifications
verified_finding: The AL1 spotlight is specified at 99 g including bracket and 32 W maximum. The platform also documents an AS1 speaker.
not_established: Enterprise accessory specs do not establish compatibility, safe payload or performance on a Mini, Tello or EC120.

title: FAA operating restrictions / TFRs
verified_finding: FAA describes operating restrictions and temporary flight restrictions, including emergency-related contexts.
not_established: Calling a mission an emergency does not establish an exception or flight authorization for a private operator.

title: FCC through-wall UWB imaging requirements
verified_finding: 47 CFR 15.510 imposes operator/use restrictions on through-wall UWB systems operating under that section, including government-authorized emergency/public-safety contexts.
not_established: Do not generalize this section to a blanket ban on all WiFi sensing. Equipment category, authorization and jurisdiction must be resolved before purchase/transmission.

title: NASA Evolved Structures Guide
verified_finding: NASA's guide addresses engineering requirements and generative design for evolved structures in mission hardware.
not_established: Design optimization is not self-certification; Haven should borrow the requirements/check/test loop rather than aerospace qualification claims.

title: FAA Part 107 waivers
verified_finding: FAA documents the waiver process and operations that may require specific approval.
not_established: No current operator, site or concurrent/BVLOS mission is qualified by this repository.

title: FDA point-of-care 3D printing discussion paper
verified_finding: FDA discusses responsibilities and considerations for medical-device manufacturing at the point of care.
not_established: A discussion paper is not device approval or a rule that any printed emergency item is suitable for clinical use.

title: whisper.cpp
verified_finding: The project supplies a local C/C++ inference implementation for Whisper speech-recognition models.
not_established: Actual latency, microphone behavior, accents and accuracy on the target PC remain untested.

title: Kokoro-82M
verified_finding: The author publishes a compact speech-generation model with Apache-licensed weights.
not_established: Check the complete runtime/voice licenses and evaluate speech quality and hardware performance.

title: Apple HealthKit authorization
verified_finding: Official authorization documentation identified; detailed requirements are retained from the prior design as pending exact native-app qualification.
not_established: This session retrieved a JavaScript shell rather than complete text. Do not label new API-specific claims freshly verified from that shell.
